beats.text: Six quiet signs of a genuinely good person.
One. They're kind to people who can do absolutely nothing for them.
Two. They don't need credit for the good they do. The doing is the point.
Three. They tell you the truth gently — even when a lie would be easier.
Four. They keep secrets, and they keep their word. You feel safe with them.
Five. They're genuinely happy when good things happen to other people.
Six. Watch how they treat the waiter, not the boss. That's where the real character shows.
Goodness is rarely loud. It's mostly what someone does when no one's keeping score.
